# Peptide South Africa

> Mobile-first South African workspace for source-led peptide research, user-entered routine records, inventory, bloodwork uploads, order tracking, and guided-support routing. General information only; not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or a product recommendation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Choose a guided or research pathway, then access the relevant dashboard tools.
- [COA Verification](/coa-verification): Certificate of Analysis verification for peptide vendors.
- [Bloodwork](/bloodwork): AI-assisted extraction of values from an uploaded report for review; clinical interpretation is routed to a qualified professional.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How user data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of the platform.
- [Disclaimer](/disclaimer): Research-only safety disclaimer.

## Peptide research library

- [BPC-157](/peptides/bpc-157): Source-led BPC-157 research profile.
- [TB-500](/peptides/tb-500): Source-led TB-500 research profile.
- [Retatrutide](/peptides/retatrutide): Investigational retatrutide research profile.
- [Tirzepatide](/peptides/tirzepatide): Tirzepatide mechanism and study profile.
- [Semaglutide](/peptides/semaglutide): Semaglutide mechanism and study profile.
- [Ipamorelin](/peptides/ipamorelin): Ipamorelin research profile.
- [CJC-1295](/peptides/cjc-1295): CJC-1295 research profile.
- [GHK-Cu](/peptides/ghk-cu): GHK-Cu research profile.
- [Epitalon](/peptides/epitalon): Epitalon research profile.
- [SS-31](/peptides/ss-31): SS-31 research profile.

## Categories

- [Healing peptides](/categories/healing): BPC-157, TB-500, and recovery research.
- [Metabolic and weight-management research](/categories/weight-loss): GLP-1 and multi-agonist study profiles.
- [Longevity peptides](/categories/longevity): Telomerase and senescence research.
- [Cognitive peptides](/categories/cognitive): Semax, Selank, and nootropic research.
- [Growth-hormone pathway research](/categories/growth-hormone): Ipamorelin and CJC-1295 study profiles.
- [Immune peptides](/categories/immune): Thymosin Alpha-1, Thymalin research.

## Boundaries

- The app does not invent clinical advice, dosages, treatment selection, or medical outcomes.
- Guided-support routing is used for suitability, treatment, monitoring, injection and other clinical questions.
- Research catalogue links are navigation paths and are not personalised recommendations.
